brief.headline: Nifty Set for Cautious Open as US Futures Rally Offsets Brent and Rate Concerns
brief.summary: Nifty 50 ended lower at 25801.65 yesterday, but strong rallies in US index futures and Asian equities provide supportive global cues. Pressure remains on macro fronts with Brent at $92.26 and domestic bond yields sensitive to RBI food inflation warnings. Stock action focuses on gold financiers, IT margins, and Tata Group corporate developments.

takeaways.text: Nifty futures face mixed cues as S&P 500 Futures gain 1.73% and Nasdaq Futures rise 2.54% despite previous session's domestic declines.
Gold finance lenders and jewellers gain traction following a sharp recovery in gold prices to $3663.8.
Indian government bonds face pressure after Brent crude crossed $95 and the RBI flagged food inflation risks.
Nvidia halted chip shipments to Southeast Asia under intensified US export controls restricting Chinese access to AI compute.
Jefferies warns of IT margin compression, estimating a 2-4 per cent EPS cut for large IT firms per 1 per cent rupee appreciation.

sections.india: Nifty closed down 0.32% at 25801.65 while Bank Nifty rose 0.15% to 63633.7. The rupee weakened by 20 paise to 92.40 against the dollar in early trades before settling at 92.778 amid oil headwinds and tariff concerns. Adani Enterprises and Adani Power intend to raise at least Rs 20 billion through public bond offerings, while the NSE obtained RBI clearance for corporate bond index futures. Zydus Lifesciences fell following a USFDA CRL for its new drug, and Tata Steel's acquisition bid for APL Apollo continues to test corporate governance dynamics.
sections.world: Global markets displayed resilience overnight as S&P 500 Futures jumped 1.73% and Nasdaq Futures surged 2.54%, while Tokyo's Nikkei 225 climbed 1.95%. Tokyo inflation picked up to its fastest rate this year, reinforcing expectations for a Bank of Japan rate hike. European markets advanced despite hawkish signals from central bankers and the confirmation of Pablo Hernandez de Cos as next ECB president. Geopolitical frictions lingered after two Italian workers died in a Kuwait drone strike amid renewed US-Iran crossfire.
sections.tech: US export controls intensified as Nvidia halted chip shipments to Southeast Asia to plug Chinese AI access channels. Counterpoint Research indicated tighter restrictions on Chinese internet labs, even as China's Weimob mapped out an in-house GPU cluster using Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 hardware. On the domestic front, Apple announced plans to launch its seventh Indian retail store in Hyderabad on December 10, 2026. IndiaMART InterMESH confirmed the resolution of its legal dispute with OpenAI.
